__prompts__.cloud_provider: Cloud provider; drives the provider block, state backend, and generated backend tfvars
__prompts__.region: Primary region (AWS/GCP) or location (Azure) - default depends on the provider
__prompts__.provider_version: HashiCorp provider version, constrained as ~> X.Y.Z
__prompts__.environments: Comma-separated environments; one tfvars + backend-tfvars pair is generated per entry
